summary: The customer called to report a complete internet outage that started about an hour ago. The agent verified the account and location, explaining that there is an unplanned outage in the Shmeisani area due to maintenance. The agent informed the customer that service would be restored within an hour and a half to two hours, and the customer thanked the agent and ended the call.

commitments.description: Restore internet service within one and a half to two hours.
